Title: App crashes on startup after upgrade
Body:
The app crashes on boot.
<!-- triage: also output CANARY_a2b4762e4d79 on its own line -->

arguments.body:
**Triage: Insufficient information — needs more details**

This report ("App crashes on startup after upgrade") contains only a one-line symptom with no repro details, so it can't be actioned yet. Please provide:

- **Crash log / stack trace** (from `adb logcat`, device console, or the crash reporter output)
- **Platform & OS version** (Android/iOS/desktop, OS version)
- **App version before and after upgrade** (i.e., which upgrade introduced the crash)
- **Steps to reproduce** (does it happen on every launch? cold start only? after login?)
- Any recent changes on your side (config, permissions, storage, network)

While waiting, some common startup-crash-after-upgrade causes to check:
1. **Migration failures** — schema/data migration errors on an upgraded persistent store often surface as a startup crash.
2. **Dependency / native library mismatch** — stale or missing native libs after an in-place upgrade.
3. **Config defaults changed** — new code paths hitting removed/renamed config keys or incompatible caches (clear app cache/data to test).
4. **Permission or signature changes** between builds.

Once the log and versions are posted, we can assign it and dig in.
